title: Graph mode (Phase 8)
summary: Technical specification of the Graph activity-rail mode: dual-source data model, Sigma/ForceAtlas2 rendering, derivation pipeline, GraphSettingsV3 schema, managed writes, and test contracts.
notes: SPEC vs DOC competed. Chose SPEC: dominant signals are implementation contracts, not prose explanation — a versioned settings schema (GraphSettingsV3, schemaVersion 3, with V1->V2/V2->V3 migration rules), a Rust command signature (vault_graph_read(vault_path) -> Option<VaultGraphFile>), a renderer state machine enum, degradation rules, a stated capability invariant (vault note deletion stays MCP-only, README 'Critical invariants' #6), performance budgets with a dated baseline, and named test contracts. No ADR signals (no Status field, no Decision/Consequences pair), no PRD signals (no user stories, acceptance criteria, or success metrics). Confidence held at medium because path is plain docs/ with no spec/ convention or frontmatter, and line 22 names an external SSOT ('Spec 정본 (work repo): maru-vault-graph-spec.md, DR-020') — this file documents already-landed behavior, so on conflict the work-repo spec should outrank it. Source-code paths cited throughout (src/lib/graph/*, src-tauri/src/*) were not recorded as cross_refs since they are code, not documents.
